nibbānapoṇañ'ca me mānasaṃ bhavissati, saṃyojanā ca me pahānaṃ gacchissanti, paramena ca sāmaññena samannāgato bhavissāmī'ti.

45093.meaning1: knowledge from observing abandoning (of); understanding from the contemplation of letting go

45094.meaning1: enjoying giving up; taking pleasure in abandoning
45094.commentary: (DNa) tattha āramanaṃ ārāmo, abhiratī'ti attho. pañcavidhe pahāne ārāmo assā'ti pahān'ārāmo.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu pahān'ārāmo hoti pahānarato, bhāvan'ārāmo hoti bhāvanārato, tāya ca pana pahān'ārāmatāya pahānaratiyā bhāvan'ārāmatāya bhāvanāratiyā n'ev'attān'ukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.

45095.meaning1: fact of enjoying giving up; fact of taking pleasure in abandoning

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu pahān'ārāmo hoti pahānarato, bhāvan'ārāmo hoti bhāvanārato, tāya ca pana pahān'ārāmatāya pahānaratiyā bhāvan'ārāmatāya bhāvanāratiyā n'ev'attān'ukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti.

45098.meaning2: having left or given up, having renounced, having forsaken, having abandoned

examples.text: so sabbaso rāg'ānusayaṃ pahāya paṭigh'ānusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā asmī'ti diṭṭhimān'ānusayaṃ samūhanitvā avijjaṃ pahāya vijjaṃ uppādetvā diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti
yo nīvaraṇe pahāya pañca, anigho tiṇṇakathaṃkatho visallo, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
